📥 Installation Instructions

To use this package in your Sad Language project:

1. Add to your sad.toml:

[dependencies] firebase-example = "^1.0.0"

2. Run package manager:

sad-pkg install

3. Use in your code:

استورد firebase_example من "firebase-example"؛ متغير registry = firebase_example.create_registry()؛

🔗 Dependencies

firebase ^1.0.0
json ^2.0.0
http ^1.5.0
